animation_layers: Open the Animation Layers manager: a floating window listing every animation layer and group in the scene.
Lock, mute, rename, and reorder layers by dragging the handle at the start of each row. Double-click a name to rename it.
Right-click one or more layers to group them, or to run a Smart Merge that bakes only the frames where the selected layers actually have weight.
Use the window's own toolbar to create a layer from the current selection, create a group, merge, delete, or import/export layers.
smart_merge: Bake the selected animation layers into one. Smart Merge samples only the frames where those layers have weight.
export: Export the selected animation layers (and their animation) to a file.
import: Import previously exported animation layers from a file.
